title: CustomEnchantCore
body:
# SMP OverEnchant Core

A **high-level enchantment system + rare enchantment meta plugin** designed for economy-driven anarchy SMP servers.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🔥 Overleveled Enchant System

* Combine enchantments beyond vanilla limits using anvils
* Supported enchantments:

  * Sharpness
  * Impaling
  * Protection (All types)
  * Thorns
  * Density
* Fully configurable max levels via `config.yml` (can be set below vanilla as well)

---

### ⚔️ Combat Changes

* **Impaling** bonus damage now applies on land (not just underwater)
* Custom **Shield Resistance Enchant**
* Custom **WindBurst Enchant** (unique mechanic)

---

### 🛠️ Admin Features

* `/overenchant give` command to grant custom enchants
* Option to disable anvil **"Too Expensive"** limit

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (config.yml)

```yaml
# Disable "Too Expensive" anvil limit
bypass-too-expensive: true

# Max enchant levels
enchant-caps:
  sharpness: 10
  impaling: 10
  protection: 10
  fire_protection: 10
  blast_protection: 10
  projectile_protection: 10
  thorns: 8
  density: 8
```

> Run `/reload` or restart the server after changes

---

## 🧩 Server Genre

> 💰 Economy-based Anarchy SMP
> ⚔️ Rare Enchantment PvP Meta
